scope: detect SARS-CoV-2 nucleoprotein peptides directly from nasopharyngeal and oropharyngeal swabs
Respiratory tract samples (combined materials from nasopharyngeal and oropharyngeal swabs) were collected in virus transport medium or sterile saline solution

Simple ethanol precipitation was used to concentrate proteins from nasopharyngeal/oropharyngeal swab specimens conserved in virus transport medium. Protein pellets were lysed by sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS), reduced, and digested by trypsin.
